name: Dennis Yang
office: Walnut Valley Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 5 (Unexpired term ending December 1, 2028)

items.text: Dennis Yang, chief information officer of the Motion Picture Association, is running for the Walnut Valley Water District Division 5 board. He says he will review expenses to avoid sudden rate hikes. He proposes using smart meters to detect leaks early and reviewing base fees for low-income households. He plans to use his information security background to protect water systems. He is treasurer of his homeowners association.
